summary: Lawrence County, Ohio tower on Wayne National Forest land; index lists it gone and a trail guide, no longer being revised, says only concrete footings remain at the far eastern end of the Vesuvius Backpack Trail.

facts.status_note: Trail guide says the tower has been dismantled and only concrete footings remain; the guide is undated and no longer being revised. No removal date found

visit.trail_note: About 9.9 miles into the Vesuvius Backpack Trail; the guide says trail conditions are worst in that stretch, passable but overgrown

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or fire history found; the Forest Lookouts Kimble page carries only the county and forest. Brief elevation_m 307.5 versus the register's 308 m: rounding, no correction. The trail guide is undated, so the current condition is as of the guide's publication. Access rated public from the trail route only; no closure or permission rule was found. Searches did not find a Kimble-specific history; an unrelated Facebook post about three Athens District towers was not used. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the story's 'reachable on foot over public forest land' wording was removed because no quote supports it; the access fact above is kept for the editor's record.
